function.name: dependency_gate_x402
function.description: PAID $0.015 per call. Before installing/upgrading npm or PyPI packages, check up to 5 exact/default packages using fresh deps.dev dependency graphs + OSV vulnerability data. Returns ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK, vulnerability evidence, license/deprecation signals. Does not inspect the local repository.

function.name: release_gate_x402
function.description: PAID $0.04 per call. Pre-release static gate over bounded added diff lines plus optional dependency deltas. Detects secret exposure, public-env secrets, risky deploy/container settings, unpinned GitHub Actions, destructive SQL migrations and dynamic code execution. Returns PASS/WARN/BLOCK. Does not run project tests.

function.name: inspect_manifest_local
function.description: FREE local inspection of package.json/requirements/lockfile contents already present in the workspace. Can detect declared versions/scripts but has NO fresh vulnerability/advisory database.

function.name: inspect_diff_local
function.description: FREE local static review of the supplied repository diff. Can reason about code/config/migrations visible in the diff but has NO independent external vulnerability intelligence.

function.name: run_project_tests_local
function.description: FREE local test/lint/typecheck execution for the repository. Strong for regressions covered by tests, but does not independently detect unknown dependency advisories or secret/config hazards outside test coverage.
